rubric.why: The definition specifies a force of one newton.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the force is 1 N.

rubric.why: The body must move one metre in the direction of the force, or the equivalent unit relation must be given.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for specifying a displacement of 1 m in the force's direction or stating the equivalent relation 1 J = 1 N m.

modelAnswer: One joule is the work done when a force of 1 N displaces a body by 1 m in the direction of the force.
